name: Home Page
description: Route-level component rendered at '/'. Orchestrates the home page by importing the static ToolDefList registry, projecting it into QuickStartRow[] and DiagramNodeList via pure functions, and composing the QuickStartTable and ClosedLoopDiagram presentational children. Contains: introductory workflow overview paragraph, a quick-start table listing all 11 tools (step number, linked tool name, one-line description), and a circular SVG flow diagram arranging the 11 tools with connecting arrows in their accent colors. All sub-components follow the dark terminal aesthetic with cyan accents.

functions.name: toDiagramNodes
functions.description: Pure projection function. Maps a ToolDefList to a DiagramNodeList by destructuring each ToolDef into { step, name, accentColor } and computing cx/cy/angleDeg from the step. Positions are computed as: angleDeg = (360 * (step - 1) / 11) - 90; cx = 300 + 240 * cos(angleDeg * π / 180); cy = 300 + 240 * sin(angleDeg * π / 180). Result is sorted ascending by step.

functions.name: ClosedLoopDiagram
functions.description: Presentational React functional component. Renders an accessible SVG circular flow diagram with viewBox='0 0 600 600', width='100%', role='img', and aria-label. Each node is a <g> containing a colored circle (or rounded rect) filled with the node's accentColor and a centered <text> label. Arrows connect consecutive nodes (1→2, 2→3, ..., 10→11, 11→1) using <line> or <path> elements with per-color <marker> arrowhead definitions. All SVG fills and strokes are set via explicit attributes — no Tailwind classes inside the <svg> element. Full TypeScript type annotation: React.FC<ClosedLoopDiagramProps>.

inputs.description: Contains sorted diagram nodes with precomputed positions, and optional className.

postconditions: Root element is an <svg> with viewBox='0 0 600 600', width='100%', role='img', and non-empty aria-label
SVG contains a <defs> section with 11 <marker> elements, one per node accent color
SVG contains exactly 11 node <g> groups, each with a filled shape and <text> label
SVG contains exactly 11 arrow elements forming the closed loop 1→2→...→11→1
No Tailwind CSS class names appear on any element inside the <svg>

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render — no side effects. All SVG is declarative.

invariants: All 11 tools from ToolDefList are always rendered in both QuickStartTable and ClosedLoopDiagram — no filtering is applied.
QuickStartRow[] and DiagramNodeList are always sorted ascending by step (1..11).
Projection functions (toQuickStartRows, toDiagramNodes) are pure — no side effects, no mutations of input.
ClosedLoopDiagram SVG uses explicit fill/stroke attributes on all elements — no Tailwind classes inside <svg>.
ClosedLoopDiagram root <svg> always carries role='img' and a non-empty aria-label.
ClosedLoopDiagram viewBox is always '0 0 600 600'; responsiveness achieved via width='100%' and max-width.
Arrow connections form a closed loop: 1→2→3→...→11→1.
Each node in the diagram is positioned at θ = (2π * (step - 1) / 11) - π/2 radians.
All exported functions and components carry full TypeScript type annotations.
Component file does not exceed 300 lines; ClosedLoopDiagram is a separate file.

data_access.rationale: Reads the static ToolDefList registry (PUBLIC classification) containing tool metadata (name, slug, step, description, accentColor) to project into table rows and diagram nodes. No user data, PII, or mutable state is accessed. No writes are performed; the component is purely presentational over static data.

side_effects.rationale: Imports static tool registry to populate quick-start table rows and circular diagram nodes.
